name: hirelume
description: Automated Resume Screening & Interview Preparation Platform — Capstone Project, Group 18

paragraphs: Hirelume is a hiring and career-fit workspace with a static web frontend, an Express API, and an Expo mobile prototype. Recruiters can publish jobs and review applications; job seekers can apply with a CV or use the separate job-fit analysis workflow.
The API and web frontend have working flows described below. The Expo app in mobile/ is currently a UI prototype: its sign-in and sign-up screens do not yet call the API.
features: Recruiter and job-seeker accounts, JWT access tokens, rotating refresh tokens,
Recruiter job creation and editing, public job links, application review,
application status history, and private CV access.
PDF and DOCX CV uploads and parsing; private CV and avatar file storage.
